correctness.rationale: Exact proof, with strict inequalities L<min(5,t+2), reduces every placement to at most two usable width-<2 orthogonal strips. Eight unit squares then force 4 in each; topmost vertical/rightmost horizontal members overlap in both axes by the inequalities in RESULT.md. Three coordinate constructions attain t+2, 5, t+1 with correct boundary t=3,4. No inference depends on numerical MILP trials.

value.rationale: Nine is the first cardinal beyond the complete 8-square optimized formulas. A single oversized square plus eight equal items is a geometrically canonical one-parameter test with sharp nontrivial plateau, exact transition points 3 and 4, and a reusable two-strip forced-overlap lemma. This result is not an unmotivated small numerical example or an area-only estimate.
